strings.zh: 梨花『哼,想向我们挑战,{NEWLINE}你还差得远呢。
strings.en: Karen: Hmph. You’re nowhere near ready{NEWLINE}to challenge us.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #202 (same zh).

strings.zh: 一树『没事就闪远点,{NEWLINE}我们可没工夫搭理你。
strings.en: Will: If you’ve got no business here,{NEWLINE}get lost. We don’t have time for you.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #203 (same zh).

strings.zh: 小豪『石英高原这里{NEWLINE}应该有珍惜精灵吧,{CLEAR}我要多抓几只！
strings.en: Goh: There must be rare Pokémon up{NEWLINE}here on the Indigo Plateau. I’m gonna{CLEAR}catch a bunch!
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #204 (same zh).

strings.zh: 千里『正赛开始前,{NEWLINE}我想自己安静地待会儿,{CLEAR}请不要理我。
strings.en: Norman: Before the main tournament{NEWLINE}starts, I’d like some time alone. Please{CLEAR}leave me be.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #205 (same zh).

strings.zh: 玉绪『小女子有幸来到此地,{NEWLINE}甚是激动。
strings.en: Tamao: This humble maiden is most{NEWLINE}fortunate to have come here. I am{CLEAR}deeply moved.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #206 (same zh).

strings.zh: 米那君『看来这人迹罕至的石英高原上{NEWLINE}也没有任何解开水君封印的线索。
strings.en: Eusine: Even here on the Indigo{NEWLINE}Plateau, where hardly anyone sets{CLEAR}foot, there’s no clue to breaking{CLEAR}Suicune’s seal.

strings.zh: 我先后向关东的马保锅老师、{NEWLINE}城都的阿四馆主{CLEAR}学习格斗系精灵的技巧,{CLEAR}现在终于学有所成{CLEAR}进入了石英大会的正赛。
strings.en: I studied Fighting-type techniques{NEWLINE}under Master Ma Baoguo in Kanto and{CLEAR}Chuck, the Gym Leader in Johto.{SCROLL}My training has finally paid off, and{NEWLINE}I’ve made it into the Indigo Conference{CLEAR}main tournament!
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #208 (same zh).

strings.zh: 百合『进入正赛的选手看起来都不弱,{NEWLINE}不能掉以轻心啊。
strings.en: Yuri: The competitors in the main{NEWLINE}tournament all look strong. I can’t let{CLEAR}my guard down.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #209 (same zh).

strings.zh: 我去年就被认定为精英训练家了,{NEWLINE}打败你们这些新人还不是小菜一碟。
strings.en: I was recognized as an Ace Trainer last{NEWLINE}year. Beating you rookies will be a piece{CLEAR}of cake.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #210 (same zh).

strings.zh: 我的精灵都是我千挑万选出来的,{NEWLINE}肯定能把你们打的落花流水。
strings.en: I handpicked every one of my Pokémon.{NEWLINE}They’ll wipe the floor with you.
strings.notes: English copied from a027/0588 #211 (same zh).
